related.title: ATV 自動補給太空船
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：教學允許區間 1.5–2.0 m，重排後通過這一維條件；仍需加入船體、其他軸與慣量。 每項結論須附輸入、單位、版本與未解限制。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: For a teaching range 1.5–2.0 m the rearrangement passes this axis, pending vehicle structure, other axes and inertia. Attach inputs, units, revision and unresolved limitations to each conclusion.
related.difference: 用二維誤差橢圓評估接近位置是否符合教學監視範圍。
related.differenceEn: Assess approach-position consistency using a two-dimensional error ellipse.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 以下皆為教學假設，非實際任務參數。教學兩件貨物為 200 kg 於 x=1 m，300 kg 於 x=3 m，忽略船體。 先按量綱手算，再以試算表獨立列式。教學名義算例：xcg=(200×1+300×3)/500。 結果約 2.2 m。xcg=Σmixi/Σmi；位置須相對同一基準，僅處理靜態質心，不代表完整慣量。
以下皆為教學假設，非實際任務參數。合成殘差 x=0.3 m、y=0.4 m，σx=0.2 m、σy=0.2 m。 先按量綱手算，再以試算表獨立列式。教學名義算例：q=(0.3/0.2)²+(0.4/0.2)²。 結果約 6.25 dimensionless。獨立二軸下 q=(x/σx)²+(y/σy)²；這是正規化殘差平方，不是以公尺表示的距離。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: All values are teaching assumptions, not mission specifications. Teaching cargo items are 200 kg at x=1 m and 300 kg at x=3 m, excluding vehicle structure. Calculate by hand with units, then independently formulate a worksheet. Synthetic nominal case: xcg=(200×1+300×3)/500. Result ≈ 2.2 m. xcg=Σmixi/Σmi requires one reference datum and describes static center of mass, not full inertia.

All values are teaching assumptions, not mission specifications. Synthetic residuals are x=0.3 m, y=0.4 m with σx=σy=0.2 m. Calculate by hand with units, then independently formulate a worksheet. Synthetic nominal case: q=(0.3/0.2)²+(0.4/0.2)². Result ≈ 6.25 dimensionless. For independent axes q=(x/σx)²+(y/σy)² is squared normalized residual, not distance in meters.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: CubeSat 小衛星系統工程
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：教學允許區間 1.5–2.0 m，重排後通過這一維條件；仍需加入船體、其他軸與慣量。 每項結論須附輸入、單位、版本與未解限制。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: For a teaching range 1.5–2.0 m the rearrangement passes this axis, pending vehicle structure, other axes and inertia. Attach inputs, units, revision and unresolved limitations to each conclusion.
related.difference: 建立一個軌道週期的能量帳，區分平均功率與日照／地影排程。
related.differenceEn: Build an orbit energy ledger separating average power from sunlit/eclipsed scheduling.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 以下皆為教學假設，非實際任務參數。教學兩件貨物為 200 kg 於 x=1 m，300 kg 於 x=3 m，忽略船體。 先按量綱手算，再以試算表獨立列式。教學名義算例：xcg=(200×1+300×3)/500。 結果約 2.2 m。xcg=Σmixi/Σmi；位置須相對同一基準，僅處理靜態質心，不代表完整慣量。
以下皆為教學假設，非實際任務參數。教學週期可收集 90 Wh，平台、通訊及載荷合計需求 80 Wh。 先按量綱手算，再以試算表獨立列式。教學名義算例：M=(90−80)/80。 結果約 0.125 fraction。能量裕度=(可收集能量−需求)/需求；必須對同一週期，另驗瞬間功率。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: All values are teaching assumptions, not mission specifications. Teaching cargo items are 200 kg at x=1 m and 300 kg at x=3 m, excluding vehicle structure. Calculate by hand with units, then independently formulate a worksheet. Synthetic nominal case: xcg=(200×1+300×3)/500. Result ≈ 2.2 m. xcg=Σmixi/Σmi requires one reference datum and describes static center of mass, not full inertia.

All values are teaching assumptions, not mission specifications. A teaching cycle harvests 90 Wh against 80 Wh total bus, communication and payload demand. Calculate by hand with units, then independently formulate a worksheet. Synthetic nominal case: M=(90−80)/80. Result ≈ 0.125 fraction. Energy margin=(harvest−demand)/demand must use one common cycle, with a separate peak-power check.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
